sections.assortmentAndAttributes: The SS26 assortment delivered $8.4M in revenue (+6.8% vs LY) across 412 options. Woodland Reserve and Westridge contributed 49% of sales, and Wire-Brushed remained the leading finish at 31%.
sections.whatsWorking:
• Water Resistant Engineered grew +12.4% and now holds 22% of sales.
  • Cluster A and B stores reached 71% sell-through, well above the 64.8% chain average.
  • Gross margin expanded to 31.6% (+0.7 pts) on lower markdown exposure.
sections.whatsNotWorking:
• Hand Scraped Hardwood fell -36.8% with margin under water on several styles.
  • Cluster F stores sold through only 49.2%, with days of supply above target.
  • Option count is down 3.5% but 11 styles still account for under 1% of sales each.
sections.whereToAdjust:
1. Re-weight buys toward Water Resistant Engineered and Stranded Bamboo for FW26.
  2. Redistribute Cluster E and F stock to A and B where the 7 missed-opportunity styles sold out.
  3. Exit or reprice the long-tail styles flagged for markdown before the summer clearance.
